highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: When you study at Ohio University, you’ll be at one of the oldest public universities in the United States. The university offers you several undergraduate and graduate programmes across various disciplines, including Business, Engineering, Health Sciences, Fine Arts, and Humanities.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll have a vibrant student life at Ohio University. You'll be part of a supportive community with over 500 student organisations. The university also offers you comprehensive wellness programmes and support services. With resources like the Academic Success Centre and the Student Accessibility Services, you'll have all the support you need.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Ohio University offers you a variety of on-campus housing options. These include residence halls and apartments. The university also provides a platform where you can search for rental listings near the campus.

Ohio University also offers special living-learning communities, where you can live alongside peers who share academic or personal interests. In addition to on-campus housing, you can also opt for off-campus living. Through the Off-Campus Housing platform, you can find listings for rental properties near the university.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At the university’s main library, the Alden Library, you'll find quiet study spaces, computer labs, and a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources.

Sports
Ohio University boasts excellent recreation facilities that cater to students of all fitness levels. The campus has a full-service gym, indoor swimming pool, and many courts for basketball, racquetball, and volleyball.

Laboratory
Ohio University offers you cutting-edge labs for engineering, biology, and many other disciplines. Notable spaces include the Ridges, which is home to various research labs focused on the environment, health, and the sciences.

Cafeteria
The university offers a wide range of dining options across campus. You’ll get meals and fresh food at the Central Dining Hall. You can also relax and refuel at the Marketside Cafe and Latitude 39. If you're looking for coffee or a quick snack between classes, you can visit the Baker University Centre.
